sentences.en: We must try to preserve the remains of ancient civilizations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须努力保护古代文明的遗迹。

sentences.en: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.
sentences.zh: 在古代，盐是一种稀有且昂贵的商品。

sentences.en: Some ancient people thought of the sun as their God.
sentences.zh: 有些古人把太阳当作他们的神祇。

senses.zh: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“安神的”→那古老的旋律让人心安神宁
